name: story-logbook-2
notes: Story panels between and after the rooms.

slots.subject: An empty clockmaker's workshop at dusk: a stool knocked over, a half-finished gear on the bench, a door left ajar, and on the dusty floor a trail of many small metal footprints leading out through the door. Nobody in the picture.
slots.camera: Wide view from a little above.
slots.composition: The open door and the trail of footprints in the centre.
